defect_found_and_fixed_during_this_step.what: First cut hid the second icon with the HTML `hidden` attribute and toggled `svg.hidden` from JS. Both icons painted at once.
defect_found_and_fixed_during_this_step.why: `hidden` is not honoured on SVG elements — the UA `[hidden]{display:none}` rule is HTML-namespace only, and `.pw-toggle svg{display:block}` (specificity 0,1,1) outranks it regardless. Setting `.hidden` from JS on an SVGElement is an expando, not a reflected attribute.
defect_found_and_fixed_during_this_step.fix: Icon visibility is now pure CSS driven off `aria-pressed` on the button, so state has one source of truth.
defect_found_and_fixed_during_this_step.evidence: before-fix eval: {eye: visible, eyeOff: visible} at rest; after-fix eval: {eyeVisible:true, eyeOffVisible:false} at rest and inverted when pressed.
